verdicts.note: Management revised FY27 credit cost guidance from 4%-4.5% down to 3.0%-4.0% in May 2026 and maintained it.
verdicts.evidence_quote: For FY27, we are guiding an AUM growth of 20.0-25.0%, NIM of 12.8-13.2%, cost to income of 33.0-35.0%, credit cost of 3.0-4.0%, ROA of 4.0-4.8%, and an ROE of 16.0-20.0%.

verdicts.note: FY27 is ongoing; AUM growth target of 20%-25% was retained in Oct 2026.
Guidance for FY27 NIM was revised upward to 14.4%-14.7% from 12.8%-13.2% in October 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7% as against 12.8% to 13.2% guided earlier, driven by healthy asset quality, strong control over borrowing costs and a higher capital position even after factoring the 50 -bps rate reduction applicable from October onwards.

verdicts.note: Cost-to-income guidance for FY27 was revised down to 29%-30% from 33.0%-35.0% in October 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: Cost to income may range between 29% to 30% as operating costs remain well under control, despite inflationary trends.

verdicts.note: Management raised FY27 ROA guidance to 5.2%-5.8% from 4.0%-4.8% in October 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.

verdicts.note: Management raised FY27 ROE guidance to 21%-24% from 16.0%-20.0% in October 2026.
verdicts.evidence_quote: We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.

verdicts.note: Target horizon is CY 2028, which has not ended yet.
